title: Easy travel companion
review_text: Compact enough for my carry-on and the grind for pour over is even. The glass cup feels solid. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Great for V60
review_text: I use about one small scoop of beans and it gives a noticeably more consistent pour-over than my old blade grinder. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Good but slower for fine grinds
review_text: It works well for French press. At a very fine setting it takes effort, which was not clear to me before buying. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Nice metal body
review_text: The aluminum body looks good and the adjustment clicks are easy to follow. The handle wiggles a little. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Not what I expected for espresso
review_text: I assumed this would make espresso as easily as an electric grinder. I can get fine grounds but turning it is hard. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Cup arrived cracked
review_text: The grinder was fine but the clear grounds cup was cracked when the package arrived. Outer box had a dent. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Burr rubbed after a week
review_text: After a week there was a rubbing sound at one setting and the crank became uneven. I contacted support. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Thought it was battery powered
review_text: The photos and wording made me think it had a motor. Returning because I wanted an electric travel grinder. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Works on camping trips
review_text: A little heavier than expected, but it is dependable and makes two small cups on a trip. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Capacity wording confused me
review_text: I tried to put 30 grams in at once and made a mess. For my usual 20 grams it is fine. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Missing handle
review_text: Package did not include the removable handle. It may have fallen out of the box, please help. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: No complaint
review_text: Does exactly what I need for a single cup at the office. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Hard to clean
review_text: Coffee dust gets around the lower threads. A cleaning brush would have helped, but I may be doing something wrong. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Gift went over well
review_text: Bought the gift set. Packaging looked clean, though I cannot say how durable it will be yet. I checked the instruction card before posting this.

title: Adjustment moved in my bag
review_text: I found the setting had shifted after travel. Maybe I did not tighten it correctly. I checked the instruction card before posting this.
